subject: pharmacology
title: Antimalarials: ACT, severe artesunate, primaquine and prophylaxis

steps.tx: **Chloroquine** (blood schizont vivax, ovale, malariae; **pruritus** dark skin, **retinopathy** chronic cumulative, cardiomyopathy, hypoglycaemia) still cures sensitive vivax while **falciparum resistance** (pfcrt) surrendered tropics; rheumatology doses eye screen annually. Overdose (QT, seizures, hypokalaemia) kills fast with diazepam debated. Pregnancy safe old standby.
steps.say: Vivax sensitive still chloroquine; falciparum resistant tropics. Chronic eyes screen; overdose QT seizes.

steps.tx: **ACT** (**artemether with lumefantrine** 3 days **fatty food**, DHA with piperaquine QT longer, artesunate with amodiaquine neutropenia, pyronaridine newcomer) clears falciparum fast with lumefantrine tail; **vomiting redose**, QT with ECG selected. **Kelch13 artemisinin resistance** (SE Asia delayed clearance, triple ACT debated) surveils; counterfeit drugs fail. Weight bands dose children.
steps.say: Fatty food 3 days clears falciparum; vomited redoses. Kelch13 delays SE Asia: triple debates.

steps.tx: **Severe malaria** (cerebral, acidosis, hyperparasitaemia, renal, ARDS, hypoglycaemia) gets **IV artesunate** (**superior to quinine**, faster, safer, hypoglycaemia rarer; **delayed haemolysis** weeks PADH watched) with ICU support; **quinine** (cinchonism tinnitus, **hypoglycaemia** insulin, QT, loading doses) infuses when artesunate absent. Exchange transfusion retired; fluids conservative ARDS. Parasite density with lactate gates.
steps.say: Cerebral severe IV artesunate beats quinine safer faster; delayed haemolysis weeks watches. Quinine deafens hypoglycaemias.

steps.tx: **Primaquine** (**hypnozoite radical cure** vivax ovale, **gametocytocidal** falciparum single low dose, **G6PD haemolysis** screened, pregnancy banned) with **tafenoquine** (single dose G6PD quantitative) finishes; **prophylaxis** (**doxycycline** sun sensitive, **mefloquine** vivid dreams psychosis banned, **atovaquone with proguanil** pricey safe, primaquine terminal) by resistance and trip. **SP-IPTp** (sulfadoxine pyrimethamine pregnancy, folate high dose avoided) protects; standby emergency treatment travellers carry.
steps.say: G6PD screens primaquine radical cure; single low sterilises falciparum sex. Dreams ban mefloquine psychosis.
